cues: Bananas, mangoes, papayas and tomatoes are climacteric fruits.
As ripening starts, each releases a burst of ethylene, and its respiration surges.
The burst is autocatalytic: ethylene triggers more ethylene.
So one ripe banana in a closed basket ripens all its neighbours.
